rq.q: A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift

m.h:
Off-hand dragon scimitar is always a loss, it is only worth buying if you're disassembling - if in doubt check the table here

The easiest method of getting to Ape Atoll is by using the Ape Atoll Teleport which teleports you very close to the shop, once you arrive, equip any greegree and run to the shop. The teleport requires the completion of Freeing King Awowogei subquest within Recipe for Disaster. If you haven't completed that quest and you have access to fairy rings you can use the code , and a small ninja monkey greegree which will teleport you to the agility course close by. Alternatively, if you have only completed Monkey Madness you can travel via the Grand Tree and Lumdo, this method will still require a greegree and is much further to travel than the other two options.

To complete this method:
-You will need magic notepaper, teleport ring/amulet and greegree

  1. Travel to Ape Atoll
  2. Equip greegree and run to the shop
  3. Don't buy the Off-hand dragon scimitar without checking the table here
  4. Buy all items and sell on the ge

m.t: Buying seaweed and pineapples from Arhein
m.pg: Money making guide/Buying seaweed and pineapples from Arhein
m.h: Arhein in Catherby will sell 80 seaweed and 40 pineapples every 24 hours, in noted form. Teleport to Catherby using the Lodestone Network and run south-west to Arhein on the docks, and quickly buy both items. Make sure to buy all of them, or else only the remaining stock will be available the next day. Arhein's stock resets 23 hours and 40 minutes after it was last bought.

m.pg: Money making guide/Buying shields from Cassie
m.h:
Shields are in demand to being essential for combat training as well as being disassembled for Invention components, due to this demand players will often pay the higher price of the GE rather than visiting the shop.

Start this method with only magic notepaper in your inventory

  1. Teleport to Falador lodestone
  2. Run south to Cassie's Shield Shop
  3. Buy all items and sell on the ge

Using the magic notepaper will cost 52,900 gp, this can be saved by running to the bank just west of the shop, taking 4 trips to buy all of the shields.

Buying summoning pouches and selling them on the GE returns a good profit for the level of effort. There are 4 summoning shops in total, with Summoning Supplies (Wishing well) and Summoning Supplies (Lord Amlodd) sharing the same stock levels. The two shops that are suggested in this guide have no requirements making this moneymaker ideal for a player with low skills.

m.pg: Money making guide/Buying supplies from Razmire
m.h:
Razmire General Store and Razmire Builders' Merchants are two shops run by Razmire Keelgan in Mort'ton. Buying some of the items he sells (olive oil, limestone bricks, planks and possibly limestone) and banking them in Burgh de Rott can be profitable. Limestone often has a better profit margin than limestone bricks, but they are usually harder to re-sell. It's of course not necessary to buy all of the items listed here -- perhaps you just want to buy the olive oil and the planks, depending on the current prices.

The fastest way to buy items from Razmire is to use drakan's medallion, a reward from The Branches of Darkmeyer quest. This allows you to teleport for free to just south of the Burgh de Rott bank. Otherwise you have to run all the way from Mort'ton to Burgh de Rott to bank. Start off next to the Burgh de Rott bank, run north and jump over the fence. Run further north to the building marked with a general store icon, trade Razmire and buy the items you want -- olive oil is in the general store, but the other items are in the building supplies store. Either teleport or run back to the bank, and repeat. Sell the items on the Grand Exchange when finished.

Shades of Mort'ton quest is needed to heal razmire from his afflicted form, by using the serum 208 (Obtained through the quest), otherwise he will sell nothing.

Players who have completed medium Morytania achievements can also claim free planks from him once daily. You're given a choice of the following:

m.t: Buying supplies from the Hunter shop
m.pg: Money making guide/Buying supplies from the Hunter shop
m.h:
The Nardah Hunter Shop sells butterfly jars for less than what they are worth, so it's profitable to run back and forth from the bank to the shop to buy the entire stock.

To get to Nardah, use the desert amulet's teleport function. If that's not available to you, use the magic carpet system. Once there, head to the hunter shop in the south and buy all of the butterfly jars, banking in Nardah as necesssary. This entire process should take 3-4 minutes if running all the time. You can then sell the jars on the Grand Exchange.

In the past magic boxes have also been profitable but they're currently not worth buying.

m.pg: Money making guide/Buying supplies from the Stonemason
m.h:
The Keldagrim Stonemason shop run by the Stonemason in Keldagrim supplies a small number of expensive construction materials. One of these, gold leaves is consistently profitable to buy from him and sell on the Grand Exchange. Purchase the items listed in the Outputs section above with non-zero quantities; those listed at zero quantity are either not profitable or do not have a high enough trade volume to support reliable sales.

The easiest way to get to the Stonemason is using the Luck of the Dwarves teleport, which brings the player just north-east of his shop. Alternatively, use the Keldagrim trapdoor in the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange. The Stonemason's shop is located in the southernmost part of Keldagrim West. Buy all of his limestone bricks — this should take 18 trips to the bank, which is found to the north-west. In the past his other stock has occasionally been profitable, but this is often not the case as those items see little use and can be obtained in small amounts at lower costs - either from the Bandit Duty Free shop in the case of marble blocks and gold leaf, or as a rare reward from Menaphite gift offerings for magic stone.

Once you've collected all the materials you want to buy, you can sell them on the Grand Exchange.

m.t: Buying vial of water and Bomb vial
m.pg: Money making guide/Buying vials of water

rq.h: Granny Rowan's Supplies shop requires tier 2 of the Botanist's Workbench

m.h:
Vials of water are used in Herblore, and are always in demand on the Grand Exchange. They are much cheaper in the shops than on the Grand Exchange, so a profit can be made easily by buying vial of water from the shops and selling on the Grand Exchange. With the addition of bomb vials that can be bought from Jatix in Taverley, Lady Meilyr in Prifddinas and Granny Rowan in Fort Forinthry one can significantly increase profit at little to no time cost.

1. Teleport to the Taverley lodestone and head south-east to Jatix.
2. Teleport to the Prifddinas lodestone (must have completed Plague's End) and head north to Lady Meilyr.
3. Use the Lighthouse Teleport (must have completed Horror from the Deep) and head upstairs to Jossik.
4. Use the Juju teleport spiritbag (must have completed Shilo Village) and head west into Shilo Village to Obli (general store). For a faster route, if you have Karamja gloves 3, use its teleport and walk south from the gem mine.
5. Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone and head north to the Botanist's Workbench, trade with Granny Rowan
Profit can be slightly increased by buying white berries, limpwurt roots, and unicorn horn dust as well. It takes nearly a week (6 days and 16 hours) to get stock back up to 40 vial of water packs.

m.h:
After completing The Fremennik Isles, Vanligga Gastfrihet will sell you 70 Yak-hide packs per week.

There are multiple ways to get to Jatizso, but the easiest are using a Rellekka tablet and running north to the Rellekka dock, using the Fremennik Province lodestone, using the Lunar Isle lodestone and using the Lady Zay and Lokar Searunner to get to Rellekka, or by simply toggling the Enchanted lyre teleport to Jatizso, after completion of the elite Fremennik Tasks.

Once on the island, head to the store and purchase the 70 Yak-Hide packs. Additionally, one can use Surge to travel nearly instantly to Vanligga Gastfrihet by moving one square northwest from the square immediately north of the banker Magnus Gram and using Surge. Alternatively, by clicking on Vanligga and immediately using Surge. After you have bought all of them, you can sell them on the Grand Exchange, where they should sell quickly as they are popular Summoning tertiaries.
m.post: Yak-hide packs respawn gradually over 1 week. They can be bought at any time with the reduced stock.

m.pg: Money making guide/Casting Bones to Bananas

rq.h: Hard Lumbridge achievements recommended for Explorer's ring 4

m.h: One can cast Bones to Bananas on an inventory of Bones (115 gp) to turn them into bananas.
m.post:
Bananas are primarily used in Summoning to create the Fruit bat familiar, and as a cheap source of fruity mush.

The spell costs a total of 1 nature rune, 2 earth runes and 2 water runes per inventory converted equaling 2800*(5824-2990-397-32) gp wielding a Staff of water or 2800*(6048-3105-397) gp wielding a Mud battlestaff. The staff of water removes the need of any water runes and the Mud battlestaff (members) removes the need of any water runes and earth runes. If wielding the staff of water set up one of your quick presets to withdraw 26 bones, 1 nature rune and 2 earth runes. For members wielding the Mud battlestaff this would be 27 bones and 1 nature rune. Cast Bones to Bananas, which will cause the bones in your inventory to turn into bananas. Open the bank, click the Quick Preset, and repeat.

The Explorer's ring 4 gives a 50% chance of casting Bones to Bananas for free for up to 10 times per day, somewhat reducing the cost of this money-making method.

The method is most effective in low latency servers at a vacant bank. Use the Quick Preset hotkey "1", positioning mouse at the bank, put Bones to Bananas on keybind "Q" and continuously hold the key. It is possible to cast 2,800 spells per hour. The bank should be clicked immediately as the bank window has closed, and press "1" again immediately when bank is opened. This totals to 72,800 bones converted in an hour wielding a staff of water/earth, and 75,600 bones if wielding the mud battlestaff. Bones have a buy limit of 10,000, so if you intend to process larger quantities, you will need to plan ahead. It is possible to work around the limit by letting the order fill while doing other activities, directly trading with other players, or by using alternate accounts.

m.t: Casting High Level Alchemy on ascendri bolts (e)
m.pg: Money making guide/Casting High Level Alchemy on ascendri bolts (e)
m.h:
This simple money making method is made by casting High Level Alchemy on Ascendri bolts (e). Efficient casting can complete 1200 casts per hour. Usually moving the item in the inventory to line up with the cast High Level Alchemy spell on the normal Spellbook

This can be done anywhere as there is no need to bank.

m.t: Casting High Level Alchemy on onyx bolts (e)
m.pg: Money making guide/Casting High Level Alchemy on onyx bolts (e)
m.h:
Casting High Level Alchemy on onyx bolts (e) is a low-effort, semi-AFK money making and Magic training method that converts purchased onyx bolts (e) into coins via the High Level Alchemy spell. Because onyx bolts (e) have a high buy limit (11,000 per 4 hours) and a strong alch margin, this is one of the more sustainable high alching targets for stacking up casts without running into Grand Exchange limits.

High Level Alchemy converts an item into coins equal to 60% of its base value, and takes 5 game ticks (3 seconds) to cast, allowing a maximum of 1,200 casts per hour. Equipping a staff of fire or similar fire-providing staff removes the need to supply fire runes, leaving the nature runes as the only consumable cost per cast.

At a Grand Exchange price of 7,233 coins per bolt and a High Alchemy value of 9,000 coins, each cast nets roughly 1,395 coins before the nature rune cost is considered (9,000 − 7,233), with the nature rune (372 coins) bringing per-cast profit to approximately 1,395 coins and an hourly profit of roughly 1.67M coins at maximum cast speed. Profit margins shift constantly with the GE price of both Onyx bolts (e) and nature runes, so check current prices before buying in bulk.

The 11,000-per-4-hour buy limit on Onyx bolts (e) and the 13,000-per-4-hour limit on nature runes both comfortably exceed the 1,200 casts achievable in a single hour, making this method viable for multi-hour sessions without needing to rotate through alternate accounts or items.
m.post:
Steps
  1. Equip a fire staff to remove the fire rune requirement.
  2. Buy Onyx bolts (e) and Nature runes from the Grand Exchange.
  3. Bank the bolts and runes, then cast High Level Alchemy on the bolts repeatedly (noted bolts can be alched directly without unnoting).
  4. Restock every 11,000 bolts / 13,000 nature runes as Grand Exchange buy limits refresh every 4 hours.
Notes
  • This method is essentially identical in setup to alching other GE-limit-friendly items (e.g. Onyx dragon bolts (e), rune items); Onyx bolts (e) are popular because the margin tends to stay positive more consistently than common rune-equipment alch targets.
  • Because the spell is largely AFK between clicks, players often combine this with other low-engagement activities (e.g. watching for Slayer task pop-ups) if running it for the Magic XP rather than pure profit.
  • Always recheck the live GE price of Onyx bolts (e) and nature runes before bulk-buying; a small price swing can flip this from profitable to a loss given the relatively tight margin per cast.

rq.h: or Large or Grasping rune pouch containing Astral runes

m.h:
The Superglass Make lunar spell can instantly turn an inventory full of sand and soda ash into molten glass. Withdraw sand and soda ash from your bank, activate Superglass Make, bank the resulting glass and repeat. On average 1.3 glass will be made for every sand-soda ash pair.

This can be done efficiently by using the same keybind for the bank preset and the spell on an action bar. For instance, using the first preset (keybind ) and placing the Superglass Make spell on an action bar with the keybind makes it possible to go through the crafting process by only pressing and clicking the bank. This way it's possible to cast the spell about 2,000 times an hour.

Another, more click-intensive method is by positioning your camera so when you right click a bank chest or banker the cursor already is over the "Load last Preset from" option, and then almost immediately pressing the keybind for Superglass Make. Utilizing this method allows one cast of Superglass Make every Game tick, or 6,000 casts an hour assuming perfect uninterrupted timing.

The large or grasping rune pouch can be used to store Astral runes and then equipped, meaning you can convert 14 sets of sand and soda ash per cast instead of only 13, increasing the profit per hour by about 7%. The Elemental battlestaff supplies unlimited fire and air runes, further increasing profit.

Note that the buy limit for both buckets of sand and soda ashes on the Grand Exchange is 10,000 every four hours. It might be necessary to stock up beforehand to reach the output quantities shown on this guide.

A Fruit Bat scroll (Fruitfall) send the fruit bat foraging for fruit, and produces papayas, oranges, limes, pineapples and bananas.

The most profitable and time-efficient of these is the papaya, which you will be collecting. The papaya is used in the creation of Adrenaline potions which are in high demand from pvmers.

Turn on Area loot in the options for faster and easier looting.

  1. Stand outside a bank with an open area near it - Edgeville and Clan Wars work well.
  2. Summon your fruit bat, withdraw your stack of Fruit Bat scroll (Fruitfall)s, and bring two Summoning potions.
  3. Start repeatedly using the fruitfall move - putting it on your action bar is helpful. When your special move points run out, drink a dose of the potion. You can use fruitfall 20 or 30 times, letting the fruit stack up near you.
  4. Collect all of the papayas (they should be on the top unless there are oranges) and bank them.
  5. Repeat this indefinitely, occasionally withdrawing the bat's own foraged fruit, and summoning a new one when the familiar timer runs out.

The most efficient method is to set a key-bind to open the "area loot" feature in Settings > Controls > Action Bar to pick them up without moving.

Siphon self is the special move of the nightmare muspah. Using it generates an amount of energy relevant to your Divination level. From 95 Divination, it generates primarily incandescent energy, as well as luminous, radiant, and elder energy. It also generates some portents of degradation III and signs of the porter vi. This uses 20 special move points, meaning it can be used 90 times per hour without summoning potions. As this method requires very little effort and only a single inventory space, it can easily be combined with other money making methods. Gathering divine energy in particular may be a good fit, as the nightmare muspah provides other benefits when training Divination.

Muspah scroll (Siphon Self)s can prove hard to buy on the Grand Exchange, so buying pouches and making scrolls instead may be a more reliable option. This changes the cost per scroll from 3,048 gp to 2,750.9 gp, and the hourly profit from 124695+47677.5+104160+19200+45813.6 - (28334.27+274320) round -3 gp to 124695+47677.5+104160+19200+45813.6 - (275915.27) round -3 gp

When first starting you will already have 60 summoning points, allowing an additional 3 scrolls to be used during the first hour.

Using Summoning potions

It is possible to use more scrolls per hour by using summoning potions to restore summoning points. The high cost of summoning potions compared to the profits this method provides means this is often not worth doing, but the method is documented below. Currently, this would provide an hourly profit (or loss) of 1662600+635700+1388800+256000+610848 - (28334.27+3657600+3024750) gp

Siphon self can be cast every 5 ticks, and consumes 20 points. Thus, can use 1,200 scrolls per hour, requiring 24,000 special move points per hour. Natural regeneration restores 1,800, which means exactly 370 4-dose summoning potions are needed to make up the rest. (You get 60 points when you summon the familiar and haven't used special moves for over 2 minutes - i.e. when just starting after a break - saving one potion.) As there is a cooldown on how often the move can be used, banking to refresh your inventory should not consume any additional time, if timed and executed well. You should also only need to bank every 4 minutes and 12 seconds, additionally mitigating any time lost by banking.

You should set up a bank preset that empties your familiar and fills your inventory with summoning potions. You should also add a summoning potion to your action bar, set your familiar action to 'use special move', and bind keys to 'familiar action' and the summoning potion action bar slot (you don't need one of each potion, any one dose is fine). Thus you can (for example) click the bank, press 1 (withdraw preset), then repeat 1 (cast scroll) and 2 (drink potion) repeatedly until all the potions are done. You do not need to move from the bank, as long as the muspah can fit in the bank area.

m.post:
Capture counts assume "automatic looting" from Dundee's Crocodile Upgrades. If properly camping a single whirligig spawn and minimal crocodile movement, one can expect a capture every 6-8 seconds. Experience rates assume only 1 whirligig can be captured at once. When with the proper upgrades, one can catch up to 5. Flower baskets can be restocked while controlling a crocodile.

To avoid having the character walk around on a misclick, the customisations window can be kept open (with any tab but "wardrobe" selected).

It is important that these upgrades are unlocked:

  • Input quantities assume "Flower saving chance" from Dundee's Crocodile Upgrades.
  • Output quantities assume "Double loot chance" from Dundee's Crocodile Upgrades.

Catching Dazzling Whirligigs while missing one or both of the upgrades mentioned above poses a risk to the player's potential profit, which can result in a potential loss of money.

Calculations with the "Flower saving chance" and "Double loot chance" unlocks from Dundee's Crocodile Upgrades:

  • The "Flower saving chance" has a 25% chance to save flowers. Over time this average results in 33.33% more flowers to be used on whirligigs.
  • The "Double loot chance" has a 25% chance to double shells.
  • When both unlocks are involved, the player will obtain an average of 66% more shells, or 5 shells to 3 flowers, shown by the following equation: 1.3333 * 1.25 = 1.6666 shells per flower.
    • The Volcanic trapper outfit affects the chance to get double shells additively, increasing the double loot chance to a total of 35% chance to double shells. This means the player will receive an average of 80% more shells, or 9 shells to 5 flowers, shown by the following equation: 1.3333 * 1.35 = 1.8 shells per flower.

While it is usually recommended that the ingredients for a money making method are purchased slowly over time, the price can rapidly change from day to day due to the low trade volume. It could take several hours to slow-buy the flowers, which makes it not worth doing in bulk.

Here is an easy way to calculate the GP/hour of Dazzling Whirligigs:

  1. Increase the price on the powder of penance until it buys, this will be the price that it sells for.
  2. Multiply the purchased value of the powder by 1.6666 or 1.8 to account for both unlocks and whether or not the Volcanic trapper outfit is in use.
  3. To account for GE tax, multiply the powder's value by 0.98.
  4. Increase the price of one golden rose until they buy, this will be the price that gets compared against the powder's selling value.
  5. Compare the price of the golden roses to the powder of penance with subtraction. This is the margin of profit for one golden rose.
  6. Multiply the margin of profit by the number of golden roses used in an hour. This guide assumes 270 golden roses an hour.

Full equations with and without the Volcanic trapper outfit written out:

  • With the outfit: ((powderPrice * 1.8 * 0.98) - flowerPrice) * flowerPerHour
  • Without the outfit: ((powderPrice * 1.6666 * 0.98) - flowerPrice) * flowerPerHour

Less than 2400 because some will be saved from [[Scroll of Cleansing|SoC]]

out.nt: More can be earned with the use of the [[brooch of the gods|BotG]]

m.h: Slow buy materials for charging inert adrenaline crystals. It can take days to weeks worth of buy limits to buy enough materials to do this method for an hour or more due to the 500 buy limit of inert adrenaline crystals. With use of a portable well, modified botanist's mask, and the Brooch of the Gods, a large profit can be made after selling the charged adrenaline crystals.

Water orbs are worth 462 coins, and are created by casting Charge Water Orb on unpowered orbs at the Water Obelisk. With an equipped water staff, this requires 3 cosmic runes per cast (or 687 coins). Using a ring of duelling to teleport to Castle Wars (or the Tokkul-zo) for banking, you can charge 27 orbs per trip (one inventory slot is needed for the cosmic runes, unless you use a large rune pouch), resulting in a profit of -8,964 coins per trip (-9,296 if using large rune pouch).

The Water Obelisk is located on an island in Catherby only accessible via the Taverley dungeon. Using the map on the right as a guide through the dungeon, the round trip to the obelisk, counting banking, takes approximately 185 seconds using the 80 agility shortcut, 205 seconds using the 70 agility shortcut, or 325 seconds without any shortcuts. If you have a Dungeoneering Cape you can use the teleport option to teleport to the Taverley Hellhound Dungeon which puts you within clickable range of the ladder to the Water Obelisk, this will considerably reduce travel time.

Bear in mind that running through the Taverley dungeon places you in combat range of aggressive black demons and poison spiders.

Assuming the unpowered orbs and cosmic runes are purchased, you can make 525 water orbs an hour using the level 80 agility shortcut (-174,300 gp), 475 water orbs using the level 70 agility shortcut (-157,700 gp), and 300 water orbs using no shortcuts (-99,600 gp).

m.t: Churning cheese wheels and slicing into cheese

xp.nt: from churning.  This can be increased to up to 14336 with the Tier 1 Milky Milky farm totem perk, and to 28672 with the Tier 2 Milky Milky farm totem perk.
from slicing, assuming 5 cheese are received per cheese wheel.

out.nt: The number of cheese received from slicing the cheese wheels is variable.  At level 48 Cooking, 5 is the typical minimum.  At higher levels, an average of as many as 30 cheese can be received per cheese wheel.

m.h:
Due to the high cost of buckets of milk, they may also be bought from The Milk Shop for 12 coins, which can often be far more profitable.

This guide assumes 112 cheese wheels can be churned and sliced per hour (4 full inventories of buckets of milk), and that each cheese wheel grants the minimum of 5 cheese. At higher cooking levels, more cheese are received per cheese wheel, which will decrease the number of cheese wheels that can be processed per hour, but greatly increase the profit per cheese wheel. At level 99, assuming 30 cheese are received per cheese wheel, one full inventory of buckets of milk can be processed per hour; this adjusts the hourly profit to 1.63m gp.

One of the closest dairy churns to a bank is in the building south of the Party Room in Falador. However, the Chef's Assistant quest is required to use the churn.

  1. Teleport to Falador and run to the east bank
  2. Fill your inventory with buckets of milk
  3. Churn the milk into cheese wheels
  4. Repeat until you have turned all of the buckets of milk into cheese wheels
  5. Withdraw a few cheese wheels from your bank at a time, and right-click slice-all
  6. Sell on the GE once you have sliced all of the cheese wheels into cheese

m.t: Claiming all daily area task rewards
m.pg: Money making guide/Claiming all daily area task rewards
m.h:
Some of the Area Tasks achievements have daily claimable rewards. This guide outlines how to claim all of them in one daily run

Other notes:

  • If you have only completed up to medium Ardougne achievements or hard Ardougne achievements, 100 or 150 pure essence can be claimed instead of the full 200 from the elite
  • A bag of lost items can be claimed from any rug merchant in the desert if you have completed the easy Desert achievements. The bag has a value of 5,000 coins
  • If you have only completed up to medium Desert achievements or hard Desert achievements, 20 or 30 potato cacti can be claimed instead of the full 40 from the elite
  • If you have only completed up to easy Karamja achievements the pineapples can still be claimed
  • A hamper can be claimed from the Lumbridge Cook if you have completed hard Lumbridge achievements. The hamper has a value of roughly 2,000 coins
  • If you have completed easy Seers' Village achievements, medium Seers' Village achievements or hard Seers' Village achievements, 30, 60, or 120 flax can be claimed instead of the full 200 from the elite
  • If you have completed easy Tirannwn achievements or medium Tirannwn achievements, 15 or 30 swamp tar can be claimed from the Lletya General Store
  • If you have only completed easy, medium, or hard Underworld achievements, fewer ritual components can be claimed from Lupe
  • In the past battlestaves were profitable to purchase from Naff after completing any of the Varrock achievements, but due to updates and battlestaves falling below the shop price, they're no longer worth purchasing

m.t: Claiming buckets of sand from Bert
m.pg: Money making guide/Claiming buckets of sand from Bert
m.h: After completing the Elite Ardougne achievements, Bert can be talked to once a week to claim 420 buckets of sand which will be automatically delivered to your bank. Bert is found in Yanille, and the easiest way to reach him is to use the Yanille lodestone and run east, or by using NPC Contact from the Lunar spellbook.

m.pg: Money making guide/Claiming flax from Geoffrey
m.h:
After completing the Elite Seers' Village achievements, Geoffrey can be talked to once a week to claim 1400 noted flax. Geoffrey is found south of Seers' village, and the easiest way to reach him is to use the Seers' Village lodestone and run south east.

  • If players have done the easy Seers' Village Tasks, they can get 210 free flax a week - 17,640 gp
  • If players have done the medium Seers' Village Tasks, they can get 420 free flax a week - 35,280 gp
  • If players have done the hard Seers' Village Tasks, they can get 840 free flax a week - 70,560 gp
  • If players have done the elite Seers' Village Tasks, they can get 1400 free flax a week - 117,600 gp

m.pg: Money making guide/Claiming fruit from Dell Monti
m.h:
After completing the Elite Karamja achievements, Dell Monti will give you 140 pineapples and 140 cooking apples once a week. By far the simplest way to reach Dell Monti is by using a Brimhaven tablet, available after completing the Love Story quest. Dell Monti is directly north of the teleport spot, so you can teleport and claim the fruit in less than 15 seconds. The next best way to reach Monti is to use the Karamja lodestone, you will arrive a short distance south of him.

If you've only completed the easy tasks, Dell Monti will still give you 140 pineapples which are valued at 34,300 gp.

m.pg: Money making guide/Claiming planks from Razmire
m.h:
After completing the Medium Morytania achievements, Razmire Keelgan can be talked to once a day to claim one type of free planks (normal, oak or teak). Razmire Keelgan is found in Mort'ton.

Getting to Mort'ton
  • After levelling Zachory Bragg to level 99 in Temple Trekking the trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis takes players directly to Mort'ton.
  • A games necklace can be used to teleport to the nearby town of Burgh de Rott after unlocking the destination by playing Temple Trekking.
  • Drakan's medallion can be used to teleport to the Barrows or Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
  • A Swamp Boat can be taken directly to Mort'ton from the Hollows in the Mort Myre Swamp. The boat can be reached by the following methods:
    • From Canifis via the tunnel behind the Hair of the Dog tavern (after In Search of the Myreque)
    • From the fairy ring in the Mort Myre Swamp.
  • Running from Canifis, which requires starting Nature Spirit to enter the swamp.

m.h:
After completing the Elite Desert achievements, the Weird Old Man can be talked to once a week to claim 280 noted potato cactus. The Old Man is found just outside the Kalphite Hive, and the fastest way to reach him is using the fairy ring code .
